summary: Gulf Resources, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that on October 14, 2026 it received approval from the Shouguang Municipal Government to resume production at its Factories No. 2 and No. 10. The registrant, a Nasdaq-listed Chinese bromine and crude salt manufacturer, will begin facility upgrades immediately, targeting test and trial production in the fourth quarter of 2026, with revenue expected in the first half of 2027 and annual production capacity increasing more than 20%. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed. This is an operational update, not a special situation.
